subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should CodexBar collect detailed Cursor usage-event history through the existing authenticated dashboard session, and if so must users explicitly opt in beyond enabling the general cost summary?
rationale: The code cannot determine whether existing status authentication constitutes consent for account-wide event-history collection or what privacy and billing-source promise the product should make.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a dedicated setting and approved disclosure before any detailed Cursor event-history request; this provides the clearest consent and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Treat cost summary as consent
options.body: Allow the existing Show cost summary setting to authorize the remote fetch, with prominent documentation and source wording but no new setting.

options.title: Keep Cursor summary-only
options.body: Decline the private event-history dependency and leave Cursor limited to its current summary status data.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a dedicated setting and approved disclosure before any detailed Cursor event-history request; this provides the clearest consent and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner explicitly placed the product/privacy hold, described the available options, and reviewed the affected implementation.
